caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular pattern with a black scalloped border. The main area inside the border is filled with a diagonal grid of cream-colored lines, creating a lattice of diamond shapes. At the intersections of the lines, there are red squares. Within the lattice, alternating diamonds are filled with a dark brown color, some of which contain blue geometric designs accented with yellow and brownish dots and curves. The other diamonds are colored in a deep blue and remain mostly plain, while the dark brown diamonds sometimes include small white and red circles. Between the diamonds, the background is primarily dark brown, decorated with evenly spaced red and white dots. In the bottom right corner, the artist’s name, J. Z. Lefevere, is inscribed. The entire composition is set against a beige background.
title: Button Rug
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
